options: total length of the path travelled
distance in a specified direction from a point
change of speed per unit time

answer.explanation: C. Displacement is distance in a specified direction from a point.

distractor_explanations: Option 1 defines distance (the total length of path travelled), not displacement.
Option 2 describes speed, which is distance divided by time.
Option 3 correctly defines displacement: distance in a specified direction from a point.
Option 4 refers to how speed changes per unit time, which relates to acceleration.
hints: A complete displacement must say where the object is relative to a point and include direction.
Look for the option that contains both distance and a specified direction.
solution: C. Displacement is distance in a specified direction from a point.
teacher_walkthrough: Distance alone follows the path and has no direction, so A is not displacement.
B describes speed, while D refers to how speed changes.
C gives the controlled definition exactly: distance in a specified direction from a point.
